usage: Used as a noun for the mathematical idea of the square root, written as 平方根 and read ping4 fong1 gan1.
Common in school math, textbooks, and exam questions; it often appears with numbers, formulas, or symbols like √.
Usually used in formal or academic contexts rather than everyday casual speech.
When talking about a specific value, you can pair it with measure or numbers, e.g. the square root of a number in a calculation context.
